classes.label: State hospital licensing and inspection agencies
classes.definition: Authoritative state agencies or programs that license hospitals or publish hospital inspection, survey, enforcement, or compliance information.

classes.label: State health departments
classes.definition: Authoritative state health departments and their bounded hospital-data catalogs, excluding a claim that every department operates a complete hospital inventory.

classes.label: Cost-report and rate-setting authorities
classes.definition: Authoritative state bodies that collect hospital cost reports or administer hospital rate-setting programs.

classes.label: Discharge-data regulators
classes.definition: Authoritative state bodies that regulate, collect, or publish hospital discharge data or discharge-data metadata.

classes.label: APCD agencies and councils
classes.definition: Authoritative state all-payer claims database agencies, councils, or statutorily designated operators.

classes.label: Other authoritative hospital oversight catalogs
classes.definition: Other bounded first-party state hospital oversight catalogs not represented by the five more specific source classes.

classification_policy.unassessed_default: A configured cell remains not_assessed until source-class-grain repository evidence supports a stronger canonical state.
